mina: FYI onboarding kestrel30k-int4 (30k ctx). After a long prefill then forcing a KV shard eviction mid-gen, outputs diverge and regen NLL jumps.

sachin: Can you paste a repro?

mina: Repro (deterministic):
```bash
./eval_local --model kestrel30k-int4 --seed 123 --prompt tests/long_seed_30k.txt --prefill 30000 --evict-token 800 --max-tokens 200
```

mina: Log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-23T09:11:10Z] shard=4 kv_idx=49151 ropescale=1.00008
[2026-03-23T09:11:10Z] shard=5 kv_idx=0     ropescale=0.99959  <-- discontinuity after stitch
[2026-03-23T09:11:11Z] token_delta=0.27 nll_increase=+12.3%
```

oliver: I can reproduce in sim; bisect points at the int4 fused ropescale recompute during kv_restore. int8 path is fine.

mina: Disabling prefix cache removes the issue, so it's tied to restore/stitch rather than core attention.

sachin: Hypothesis: per-shard quant rounding causes slightly different ropescale values when recomputed; stitch assumes continuity.

mina: Proposed fix: compute reference ropescale from the first restored shard and apply multiplicative correction to later shards on restore. Add unit test asserting post-restore ropescale continuity <1e-4.

oliver: I'll run a small smoke (5 seeds) patched vs unpatched on GPU. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/smoke_kv.sh kestrel30k-int4 --patch normalize-ropescale --seeds 123 124 125 126 127 --prefill 32000 --evict-token 512
```

ci-bot: canary/kestrel reported regen-drift threshold breach at 2026-03-23T09:20:00Z; canary paused.

mina: If smoke looks good we backport to runtime and gate onboarding until full eval passes.

sachin: Opening PR #1320 with the normalization + test. Adding onboarding CI gate to fail on >1% regen drift for prefill+evict cases.

oliver: Early smoke shows ropescale diffs <3e-5 and NLL within baseline noise. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-ci/kestrel30k/1768007777/smoke.tar.gz

mina: Thanks all ":thumbsup:". Plan: (1) full 20-seed eval on stage, (2) backport to dedicated/runtime, (3) add integration gate in onboarding.

deploy-bot: Canary create queued for kestrel30k-int4 with PR #1320.
